raw_text: India has launched a diplomatic offensive against SFJ's planned Khalistan referendums in Canada, UK, and Australia, with the Ministry of External Affairs issuing formal demarches to all three governments. Intelligence agencies have documented extensive bot network activity amplifying the referendum campaign on social media. Times of India has learned that NIA has identified Pakistan's ISI as a key facilitator providing financial and logistical support to SFJ's operations.
clean_text: Times of India reported India's diplomatic offensive against SFJ referendums with formal demarches to Canada, UK, and Australia. NIA identified ISI as key facilitator of SFJ operations.
